Archival Dispatch: 24 Master Broadcasts Dated Across GI Jive, Strange Adventure, and AFRS Basic Music Library

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: GI Jive, GI Jill, AFRS, Strange Adventure, Mystery OTR, Basic Music Library, Bing Crosby, Ames Brothers, Spike Jones, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 35 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 35 resolves 24 historical radio master recordings across three Armed Forces and syndicated institutions: 8 Wartime Armed Forces Radio Service broadcasts of GI Jive hosted by GI Jill (Martha Wilkerson, featuring Benny Goodman, Glenn Miller, and Artie Shaw), 8 global mystery and adventure episodes from Strange Adventure (1946–1947), and 8 vinyl transcription master discs from the AFRS Basic Music Library (including Bing Crosby, The Ames Brothers, Spike Jones, Shostakovich, and Beethoven).

1. AFRS GI Jive — 1944–1945 Armed Forces Radio Service

Hosted by Martha Wilkerson ('GI Jill') for Allied service members worldwide:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate GI Jive Featured Lineup
GI_Jive_838_Benny_Goodman.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive #838: Benny Goodman ('Alexander's Ragtime Band') & Glenn Miller" 1944-11-20 High-tempo swing session featuring Goodman, Miller, and The Ink Spots.
GI_Jive_908_Benny_Goodman_Changes.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive #908: Benny Goodman ('Changes') & Red Nichols" 1945-02-09 Classic jazz cornet solos and big band swing requested by frontline units.
GI_Jive_Mission_To_Moscow.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive: Benny Goodman ('Mission to Moscow') & Harry James" 1944-08-14 Fast brass features and wartime novelty numbers.
GI_Jive_Benny_Strong_Youre_The_One.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive: Benny Strong ('You're the One')" 1945-03-23 Sweet melodic dance band charts for troops in Europe and the Pacific.
GI_Jive_Yank_Weekly_Dedication.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive: Yank Army Weekly Dedication Edition" 1944-06-16 Special edition co-produced with Yank: The Army Weekly magazine.
GI_Jive_US_Navy_Fleet_Dedication.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive: US Navy Fleet Dedication Edition" 1944-10-27 Navy Day broadcast dedicated to Pacific Fleet battleship and carrier crews.
GI_Jive_Glenn_Miller_Bing_Crosby.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive: Glenn Miller, Bing Crosby, and Artie Shaw" 1944-09-08 All-star vocal and swing stack spun on the AEF Jukebox of the Air.
GI_Jive_Blue_Skies_Request.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive: 'Blue Skies' Request Session" 1944-07-28 Listener request stack sent by mail from overseas military post offices.
